title: DECISION: HLC node_id derived from operator signing key, not libp2p peer ID
description: main.rs derives the HLC node_id by SHA-256 hashing the Ed25519 operator public key and taking the first 8 bytes. The comment explains the rationale: this makes node_id stable across restarts as long as the operator key file is unchanged, and globally unique assuming Ed25519 keys are not reused. Using the libp2p peer_id would couple node identity to the IPFS backend (and would break for non-Kubo backends). Using a random value per restart would make HLC timestamps non-comparable between runs.
